headings: Policies with Respect to Certain Other Activities
paragraphs: Rithm Property Trust (formerly Great Ajax Corp.), a Maryland corporation, is an externally managed REIT formed on January 30, 2014, and capitalized on March 28, 2014, by its then sole stockholder, Aspen Yo LLC, an affiliate of the Aspen Capital group of companies. The Company focuses on investments in the CRE sector.

On June 11, 2024, the Company completed its previously announced strategic transaction with Rithm (such transactions together, the "Strategic Transaction"). In connection with the Strategic Transaction, the Company entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement (the "SPA") pursuant to which, following stockholder approval on May 20, 2024, it issued $14.0 million of common stock, par value $0.01 ("Common Stock"), to Rithm. The Company also entered into a management agreement, dated June 11, 2024 (as amended by that First Amendment to the Management Agreement, dated October 18, 2024, and as further amended by that Second Amendment to the Management Agreement, dated February 12, 2026, and as may be further amended, modified or supplemented from time to time, the "Management Agreement") with RCM GA, which became the Company's external manager; terminated its prior management agreement; entered into a term loan with a subsidiary of Rithm; and issued warrants to Rithm to purchase shares of the Company's Common Stock. The Company relocated its corporate headquarters to New York, New York, and on December 2, 2024, rebranded and changed its name to Rithm Property Trust Inc.

In connection with the Strategic Transaction, the Company terminated its prior loan servicing arrangement and disposed of its interest in Great Ajax FS LLC. Effective June 1, 2024, servicing of the Company's mortgage loans and real property was transferred to Newrez, an affiliate of Rithm and the Manager, pursuant to the Servicing Transfer Agreement (as defined below). The terms of the underlying servicing agreements remain unchanged.

Under RCM GA's management, the Company repositioned its business from a predominantly residential mortgage strategy to a flexible CRE focused investment strategy, which includes originating and acquiring CRE-related investments and managing a diversified portfolio of assets. The Company believes current market conditions are creating refinancing challenges and capital dislocations in the CRE sector that may present attractive risk-adjusted investment opportunities. Target investments may include senior and subordinated mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, preferred equity, commercial mortgage servicing rights, CRE properties and other CRE-related debt and equity investments. The Company has largely transitioned away from residential mortgage loans and RMBS and does not expect to make further investments in RPLs, NPLs or RMBS.

The Company expects to finance its investments through a variety of capital sources, which may include secured and unsecured credit facilities, capital markets transactions, securitizations and other corporate financing arrangements, depending on market conditions and investment characteristics. Through its external Manager, the Company leverages Rithm's real estate and capital markets expertise across sourcing, underwriting, financing, asset management and disposition. The Company believes the flexibility of its investment strategy and its ability to actively manage assets position it to generate attractive long-term returns for stockholders across a range of market conditions.

In December 2025, as part of the execution of its CRE investment strategy, the Company acquired an indirect minority interest in PGOP, which through its affiliates and joint ventures owns a portfolio (the "PGRE Portfolio") of CRE properties, through an investment (the "PGRE Investment") in affiliated aggregator vehicles formed in connection with Rithm's acquisition of Paramount Group, Inc. ("Paramount"). The PGRE Portfolio consists of ten properties: 1633 Broadway, 1301 Avenue of the Americas, 1325 Avenue of the Americas, 31 W 52nd Street, 712 Fifth Avenue, 1600 Broadway and 900 3rd Avenue in New York, New York and One Market Plaza, 300 Mission Street and One Front Street in San Francisco, California. The Company made an initial cash investment of $50.0 million and committed to make up to an additional $7.5 million of capital contributions under certain circumstances. The PGRE Investment was approved by the Company's independent directors and was funded with cash on hand.

On December 19, 2025, the Company's board of directors (the "Board of Directors") approved a reverse stock split, which was effected on December 30, 2025, of its Common Stock at a ratio of one share for every six shares issued and outstanding (the "Reverse Stock Split"). Unless otherwise indicated, all share and per-share amounts in this Annual Report on Form 10-K have been retroactively adjusted to reflect the Reverse Stock Split.

We make investment decisions pursuant to broad investment guidelines adopted by our Board of Directors on June 11, 2024. As a result, we may, without obtaining stockholder approval, modify our target asset classes and acquire a range of investments that may differ from, and may be riskier than, those held in our current portfolio.

The Board of Directors has adopted these guidelines to evaluate potential investments. The guidelines prohibit any investment that would cause us to fail to qualify as a REIT or that would cause us to be regulated as an "investment company" under the Investment Company Act. The guidelines also contemplate that our investments will be primarily in the types of assets described under "Proposal 4—Management Proposal—Strategy of Rithm" in the Company's definitive proxy statement filed with the United States ("U.S.") Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on April 10, 2024. The Board of Directors may amend the investment guidelines at any time, without stockholder approval. If the Board of Directors materially modifies the investment guidelines, we will disclose the change in our next required periodic report or otherwise as required by applicable law.

All of our investment activities are conducted by our external Manager pursuant to the Management Agreement, which remains in effect until June 11, 2027 and will automatically renew for successive two-year terms, subject to certain termination rights as described therein. Our principal objective is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our stockholders over the long-term through dividends and capital appreciation.

Our objective is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our stockholders, and we may use leverage as part of our strategy. The amount of leverage we use for a particular investment is determined based on a range of factors, which may include the expected liquidity and price volatility of the asset; the duration profile of our assets and liabilities (including any hedges); the availability and cost of financing; our assessment of the creditworthiness of financing counterparties; conditions in the U.S. economy and the commercial and residential mortgage and real estate markets; our interest rate outlook; the credit quality of the loans underlying our investments; and our view of asset spreads relative to financing costs. See Note 9—Debt to our consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report for additional information regarding our debt obligations.

We do not currently hedge portfolio risks associated with our investment portfolio. However, we may seek to mitigate interest rate risk related to our financing obligations. Our financing arrangements may from time to time bear interest at floating rates, typically based on a stated spread over a reference index. A sustained increase in interest rates could increase our financing costs. To manage this exposure, we may use derivative instruments, such as interest rate swaps or interest rate options, to reduce the variability of earnings attributable to changes in the interest rates applicable to our debt. We may also seek to align our interest rate exposure by funding floating-rate investments with floating-rate liabilities.

Any derivative transactions would be entered into solely for risk management purposes and not for investment or speculative purposes. The use of derivatives may expose us to certain risks, including market and interest rate risk, timing and volatility risk, counterparty and credit risk, and reduced market liquidity. As a result, derivatives may not be effective in offsetting changes in our financing costs. No derivative instruments are currently outstanding.

Subject to the approval of our Board of Directors, we have the authority to offer our Common Stock or other equity or debt securities in exchange for property. We are also authorized to repurchase or otherwise reacquire our Common Stock or any other securities, and we may engage in these activities from time to time in the future.

headings: We depend on a manager to run our business, and if the Manager is unable to conduct our investment activities properly, there could be a material adverse effect on our business.
We expect to continue to incur consolidated net losses from our mortgage asset holdings.

Investments in CRE companies are subject to the specific risks relating to the particular company and to the general risks of investing in real estate-related loans and securities, which may result in significant losses.
The PGRE Investment exposes us to additional risks related to the office real estate industry.
We will have little control over the PGRE Investment and will be dependent on third parties to manage our investment, and our investment will be illiquid.
There are certain risks associated with the servicers of CRE loans.
There are certain risks associated with an investment in CMBS.
A significant portion of our residential mortgage loans may become NPLs, which could further increase the significant losses we have incurred to date.
The principal and interest payments on our MBS are not guaranteed by any entity and, therefore, are subject to increased risks, including credit risk.
Our CRE loans will be subject to the ability of the commercial property owner to generate net income from operating the property as well as the increased risks of delinquency and foreclosure.

We may be materially and adversely affected by risks affecting borrowers in which our investments may be concentrated at any given time, as well as from unfavorable changes in the related geographic regions.
Changes in the underwriting standards by Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae or the Federal Housing Administration (the "FHA") could make it more difficult to refinance our purchased mortgage loans.
The whole residential mortgage loans and other residential mortgage assets in which we have invested are subject to risk of default, among other risks.
If we acquire and subsequently re-sell any whole mortgage loans, we may be required to repurchase such loans or indemnify investors if we breach representations and warranties.

We are subject to counterparty risk and may be unable to seek indemnity or require our counterparties to repurchase mortgage loans if they breach representations and warranties, which could cause us to suffer losses.

The failure of a seller of mortgage loans to provide all the necessary documentation to us could adversely affect our ability to leverage our assets or otherwise service the mortgage loans that we will own.
Market conditions may affect our ability to securitize assets, which could increase our financing costs and adversely affect our results of operations and ability to make distributions.
Prepayment rates can change, adversely affecting the performance of our assets and our ability to reinvest the proceeds thereof.
The real estate assets and real estate-related assets we invest in are subject to the risks associated with real property.
The allocation of capital among our mortgage loans may vary, which may adversely affect our financial performance.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully read and consider the following risk factors, together with the information included under the caption "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and the other information included in this Annual Report. Our business, financial condition, cash flows and/or results of operations could be adversely affected by any of these risks, as well as additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial.

All of our investment activities are conducted by the Manager. The Manager has great latitude in determining the types of assets that are appropriate investments for us, as well as the individual investment decisions. Thus, our success will depend on our relationship with, and the performance of, the Manager. Should the Manager fail to allocate sufficient resources or select appropriate investments, we may be unable to achieve our objectives. Further, if the Manager or Rithm are unable to retain its key personnel, it may be difficult for the Manager to manage our business. Any of the foregoing could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and/or cash flows.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, we incurred a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $2.7 million. In addition, the market value of our RPLs, NPLs and small balance commercial loans have significantly deteriorated, and we have incurred substantial operating losses on loans we have sold or intend to sell. We expect to continue to incur operating losses for the foreseeable future given the current market conditions for our mortgage asset holdings.

In particular, higher historical interest rates are expected to continue to have significant negative effects on our loan assets. Increases in interest rates, the interrelationships between various rates and interest rate volatility have had, and are expected to continue to have, negative effects on our earnings because it has extended duration. This has resulted in, and is expected to continue to result in, significant decreases in the fair market value of performing loans. It also may impact adversely our ability to securitize, re-securitize or sell our assets on attractive terms. Higher interest rates may reduce the ability or desire of borrowers to refinance their loans. Mortgage related assets may become more illiquid during periods of interest rate volatility. As a result, we also may encounter difficulties refinancing our securitizations and it increases the costs of our repurchase facility financings. Higher interest rates also generally increase our financing costs as we seek to renew or replace borrowing facilities.

Many of our investments may be illiquid, and this lack of liquidity has in the past and could continue to significantly impede our ability to vary our portfolio in response to changes in economic and other conditions or to realize the value at which such investments are carried if we are required to dispose of them.

We previously acquired, and may in the future acquire, assets, securities or other instruments that are not liquid or publicly traded. Illiquidity may result from the absence of an established market for the investments, as well as legal or contractual restrictions on their resale, refinancing or other disposition. Dispositions of investments may be subject to contractual and other limitations on transfer or other restrictions that would interfere with subsequent sales of such investments or adversely affect the terms that could be obtained upon any disposition thereof. Liquidity can also be impacted by current market conditions.

paragraphs: Rithm Property Trust ( formerly Great Ajax Corp. ), 一間馬裏蘭州公司，為一間由外部管理的REIT，於2014年1月30日成立，並於2014年3月28日由其當時唯一股東Aspen Yo LLC，為Aspen Capital集團公司之一間附屬公司，資本化。本公司專注於 CRE 產業的投資。

於2024年6月11日，本公司完成先前宣佈的戰略交易（此等交易合稱為「戰略交易」）。配合戰略交易，本公司與Rithm簽訂證券購買協議（「SPA」），於2024年5月20日股東批准後，發行14.0 百萬美元的普通股，每股面額0.01美元（「普通股」）予Rithm。本公司亦與RCM GA簽訂管理協議，日期為2024年6月11日（經2024年10月18日第一次管理協議修正案、2026年2月12日第二次管理協議修正案及隨後可能修正、修改或補充的修正案，稱為「管理協議」），RCM GA成為本公司外部管理人；終止其先前管理協議；與Rithm之子公司簽訂定期貸款協議；並發行認購權證予Rithm，使其可購買本公司普通股。本公司將總部遷至紐約州紐約市，並於2024年12月2日重新品牌並更名為Rithm Property Trust Inc。
配合戰略交易，本公司終止其先前貸款服務安排，並處分其在Great Ajax FS LLC之權益。自2024年6月1日起，本公司抵押貸款及實物資產之服務轉移至Newrez，為Rithm之附屬公司及管理人，根據服務轉移協議（如下所定）。原始服務協議之條款保持不變。

在RCM GA管理下，本公司將業務重新定位，從以住宅抵押貸款為主的策略轉向靈活的CRE專注投資策略，包含發起及取得與CRE相關之投資，並管理多元化的資產組合。本公司認為目前市場條件正在造成CRE產業的再融資困難及資本動員問題，可能提供具吸引力的風險調整投資機會。目標投資可能包括高級及次級抵押貸款、Mezzanine貸款、優先股、商業抵押貸款服務權、CRE不動產及其他與CRE相關的債務及股權投資。本公司已大幅轉向住宅抵押貸款及RMBS，並預期不會進一步投資於RPLs、NPLs或RMBS。
本公司預期透過多種資金來源來資金融資其投資，可能包括有擔保及無擔保信貸設施、資本市場交易、證券化及其他企業融資安排，視市場條件及投資特性而定。透過其外部管理人，本公司運用Rithm在不動產及資本市場的專業知識，於來源、評估、融資、資產管理及處分等領域進行整合。本公司認為其投資策略的靈活性及主動管理資產的能力，使其能在不同市場條件下為股東產生具吸引力的長期回報。

於2025年12月，作為執行其CRE投資策略的一部分，本公司取得PGOP間接少數股權，PGOP透過其附屬公司及合資企業擁有CRE不動產組合（稱為「PGRE組合」），透過與Rithm收購Paramount Group, Inc.（「Paramount」）相關所設立之附屬集資工具之投資（稱為「PGRE投資」）。PGRE組合包含十處不動產：1633 Broadway、1301 Avenue of the Americas、1325 Avenue of the Americas、31 W 52nd Street、712 Fifth Avenue、1600 Broadway及900 3rd Avenue位於紐約州紐約市，以及One Market Plaza、300 Mission Street及One Front Street位於加州舊金山。本公司進行初始現金投資50.0 百萬美元，並承諾在特定情況下追加至多7.5 百萬美元之資本投入。PGRE投資已獲本公司獨立董事批准，並以現金資產支應。
於2025年12月19日，本公司董事會（「董事會」）批准反向股票分割，於2025年12月30日生效，本公司普通股以每六股換一股（「反向股票分割」）。除非另有說明，本年度10-K表報中所有股數及每股金額已回溯調整以反映反向股票分割。
我們根據董事會於2024年6月11日採納之廣泛投資指引進行投資決策。因此，我們可於不取得股東批准的情況下，修改目標資產類別，並取得範圍可能與現有投資組合不同且風險更高的投資。

董事會已採納這些準則以評估潛在投資。這些準則禁止任何會導致本公司無法符合REIT資格或會導致本公司被視為根據《投資公司法》受規範的「投資公司」之投資。這些準則亦預期本公司之投資將主要為「提議4—管理提議—Rithm策略」中所描述的資產類型，該內容載於本公司於2024年4月10日向美國（"U.S.")證券交易委員會（"SEC"）提交的最終股東授權書中。董事會可隨時修改投資準則，無需股東批准。若董事會重大修改投資準則，本公司將在下次所需定期報告或依適用法律之要求揭露此變更。
所有投資活動均由本公司外部管理人根據管理協議進行，該協議自2027年6月11日起生效，並會自動續約為連續兩年期，除非協議中所述之終止權被行使。本公司之主要目標是透過股息與資本增值，為股東在長遠期間產生具吸引力的風險調整後回報。

本公司之目標是為股東產生具吸引力的風險調整後回報，並可能使用槓桿作為策略之一部分。我們對特定投資所使用槓桿的金額，係根據多種因素決定，這些因素可能包括資產之預期流動性與價格波動性；資產與負債之期限結構（包括任何避險措施）；融資之可取得性與成本；我們對融資對手之信用worthiness之評估；美國經濟狀況與商業及住宅房貸與不動產市場狀況；我們對利率之展望；我們投資之貸款之信用品質；以及我們對資產利差相對於融資成本之看法。有關我們債務義務之更多資訊，請參閱本年報所附財務報表之附註9—債務。
本公司目前未對投資組合所產生之投資組合風險進行避險。然而，我們可能尋求緩解與融資義務相關之利率風險。我們之融資安排可能時而以浮動利率計息，通常基於某一定期指數之上浮幅度。利率持續上升可能增加我們之融資成本。為管理此風險，我們可能使用衍生性金融商品，如利率交換或利率選擇權，以減少因適用於我們債務之利率變動而產生之收益變動性。我們也可能透過以浮動利率融資來資助浮動利率投資，以對齊利率風險。
任何衍生性交易均 solely 用於風險管理目的，而非投資或投機目的。使用衍生性金融商品可能使本公司面臨某些風險，包括市場與利率風險、時間與波動性風險、交易對手與信用風險，以及市場流動性降低。因此，衍生性金融商品可能無法有效抵銷我們之融資成本變動。目前無任何衍生性金融商品為本公司所持有。
經董事會批准後，本公司有權以發行普通股或其它權益或債務證券，換取財產。本公司亦有權買回或以其他方式重新取得本公司普通股或任何其他證券，並可能在未來不時進行這些活動。

paragraphs: 2025年12月，本公司為執行其 CRE 投資策略，取得 PGOP 的間接少數股權，PGOP 透過其附屬公司及合資企業擁有 PGRE 資產組合，透過 PGRE 投資取得。PGRE 資產組合包含十處不動產：1633 Broadway、1301 Avenue of the Americas、1325 Avenue of the Americas、31 W 52nd Street、712 Fifth Avenue、1600 Broadway 和 900 3rd Avenue 在紐約州紐約市，以及 One Market Plaza、300 Mission Street 和 One Front Street 在加州舊金山市。本公司進行初始現金投資 50.0 百萬美元，並承諾在特定情況下追加至多 7.5 百萬美元的資本投入。此投資已獲本公司獨立董事批准，並以現金資產資金支應。
2025年12月19日，本公司董事會批准實施反向股票分割，於2025年12月30日生效，本公司普通股的分割比例為每持有六股換發一股。除非另有說明，本 10-K 年度報告中所有股數及每股金額均已追溯調整以反映此反向股票分割。
2026年2月，本公司評估了一項發行普通股的潛在方案，以籌資購入商業抵押貸款資產。考慮當時市場情況，本公司決定不於當時進行股權發行或相關購入。本公司持續評估資本市場活動及戰略投資機會，以期為股東帶來利益。
下表列出本公司於2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日，抵押貸款資產、證券投資、其他投資及 REO 的帳面價值：

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們依賴一位經理人來經營我們的業務，若經理人無法妥善執行我們的投資活動，可能會對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
我們預期將持續產生來自房貸資產持有的合併淨虧損。
對商業不動產（CRE）公司的投資會面臨與特定公司相關的風險，以及投資於與不動產相關貸款及證券的一般風險，這可能會導致重大損失。
PGRE 投資會使我們面臨與辦公室不動產產業相關的額外風險。
我們對 PGRE 投資將擁有很有限的控制權，並將依賴第三方來管理我們的投資，且我們的投資將缺乏流動性。
與 CRE 貸款的服務機構相關的風險。
與投資於 CMBS 相關的風險。
本公司所持有的住宅房貸貸款中，有相當大一部分可能成為不良貸款，這可能會進一步增加本公司迄今為止所遭受的重大損失。
本公司MBS的本金與利息支付並未由任何機構擔保，因此可能面臨更高的風險，包括信用風險。
本公司持有的商業不動產貸款將取決於商業不動產所有者能否從經營該不動產中產生淨收入，以及面臨更高的違約與法拍風險。
本公司可能因投資集中於特定借款人，或相關地理區域出現不利變動而受到重大且不利的影響。
房利美、房地美或聯邦住房管理局（"FHA"）的承貸標準變動，可能使本公司所購入的房貸貸款更難以進行再融資。
本公司所投資的全部住宅房貸貸款及其他住宅房貸資產，均面臨違約風險，以及其他風險。
若本公司取得並隨後轉售任何全部房貸貸款，本公司可能被要求回購這些貸款，或在本公司違反說明與保證時，需賠償投資人。
本公司面臨交易對手風險，且可能無法尋求賠償或要求交易對手回購房貸貸款，若交易對手違反說明與保證，這可能會導致本公司遭受損失。
賣方未能提供所有必要的文件給我們，可能會不利於我們運用資產或服務我們所擁有的房貸貸款的能力。
市場狀況可能影響我們資產的證券化能力，這可能會提高我們的融資成本，並不利於我們的營運結果與發放現金紅利的能力。
預付率可能變化，不利於我們資產的表現與我們重新投資所得款項的能力。
我們投資的不動產資產與不動產相關資產，會面臨與不動產相關的風險。
我們在房貸貸款之間的資本配置可能有所不同，這可能會不利於我們的財務表現。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的證券涉及高度風險。您應仔細閱讀並考慮下列風險因素，並配合本年度報告中標題為「關於前瞻性陳述的警示聲明」及其它資訊。本公司業務、財務狀況、現金流及/或營運成果可能因任何上述風險，以及目前尚未知悉或本公司認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性而受到不利影響。
本公司所有投資活動均由經理人執行。經理人對於適合本公司投資的資產類型，以及個別投資決策擁有廣泛的裁量權。因此，本公司之成功將取決於與經理人之關係及其表現。若經理人未能分配足夠資源或選擇適當投資，本公司可能無法達成目標。此外，若經理人或 Rithm 無法留住關鍵人員，經理人可能難以管理本公司業務。任何上述情形均可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果及/或現金流產生重大不利影響。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，本公司歸屬於普通股股東之淨虧損為 2.7 百萬美元。此外，本公司 RPLs、NPLs 及小額商業貸款之市價已顯著惡化，且本公司已就已出售或預計出售之貸款產生重大營運虧損。考慮目前本公司房貸資產之市場條件，本公司預期將持續在可預見之未來產生營運虧損。

特別是，較高的歷史利率預期將持續對本公司貸款資產產生顯著負面影響。利率上升、各類利率之間的相互關係及利率波動已對本公司獲利產生負面影響，並預期將持續如此，因貸款之期限已延長。此已導致，並預期將持續導致，表現良好貸款之公允市價顯著下降。此亦可能不利於本公司對資產進行證券化、再證券化或出售之能力，且可能不利於本公司在有利條件下出售資產。較高的利率可能降低借款者重組貸款之意願或能力。在利率波動期間，與房貸相關之資產可能變得較不流動。因此，本公司亦可能遇到重組證券化之困難，並增加本公司購回融資之成本。較高的利率通常也會提高本公司之融資成本，因本公司需尋求更新或取代借款融資。
本公司許多投資可能為非流動性，且此缺乏流動性在過去已對本公司變動投資組合以應對經濟及其他條件之變化，或在被迫處置時實現投資之價值造成顯著阻礙。
本公司先前已取得，且可能在未來取得非流動或未上市交易之資產、證券或其他工具。缺乏流動性可能來自投資無具備現行市場之情形，以及法律或契約對其轉讓、再融資或其他處置之限制。投資之處置可能受契約及其他轉讓限制或其它限制影響，可能幹擾後續出售該投資，或對任何處置所取得之條件產生不利影響。流動性亦可能受當前市場條件影響。
